lead.title: NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX inference accelerator enters full production at 3,400 tokens/sec, Vera CPU detailed
lead.summary: At Hot Chips 2026, NVIDIA announced its dedicated Groq 3 LPX inference chip entering full production with 3,400 tokens/sec on Gemma 4 31B at 100K context, purpose-built for agentic AI on the Vera Rubin NVL72 platform. The company also detailed its Vera 88-core Arm server CPU with LPDDR5X memory and 96 PCIe Gen6 lanes. Nebius is Groq 3 LPX's first customer.

top_stories.title: Arm unveils first in-house AGI data center CPU at Hot Chips 2026: 136 Neoverse V3 cores
top_stories.summary: Arm presented its first complete commercial CPU design at Hot Chips, built on TSMC N3P with dual chiplets (>50B transistors each), up to 136 Neoverse V3 cores at 3.7 GHz, 800+ GB/s memory bandwidth, and 96 PCIe Gen6 lanes at 300W TDP. Demand forecast raised to $2B for 2027-2028.

top_stories.title: XPeng Robotics raises $900M+ at $6.3B valuation from Alibaba, Tencent, IDG Capital
top_stories.summary: XPeng Robotics raised over $900M in its first funding round led by IDG Capital, with GaoRong Capital, Tencent, and Alibaba as strategic investors. Funds target mass production of the IRON humanoid robot and global commercial deployment. Record single PE round in China's embodied intelligence sector.

top_stories.title: Hugging Face reportedly in talks to be acquired for $13B
top_stories.summary: The AI model hub and open-source platform is reportedly in acquisition talks at a $13B+ valuation, having engaged banks to evaluate bids. The potential sale follows surging demand for AI infrastructure; Hugging Face last raised at $4.5B in 2023.

top_stories.title: General Intuition in talks to raise at $6B valuation backed by Valor and Point72
top_stories.summary: General Intuition, building foundation models for physical AI agents, is in talks at a $6B pre-money valuation with Valor Equity Partners, Point72 Ventures, and Seven Seven Six joining existing backers Khosla Ventures and General Catalyst in an oversubscribed round.

items.title: How to train a critic stably and efficiently for GRPO-based LLM post-training
items.summary: Proposes a stable critic training recipe showing that a well-trained critic can estimate token-level advantages from a single response matching GRPO's multi-sample performance.

items.title: Reward-free continual adaptation for resilient space robots
items.summary: Introduces a reward-free continual RL framework for space robots under hardware degradation, removing the need for reward signals during deployment while maintaining online adaptation.

items.title: Credal LLMs for semantic commitment under uncertainty
items.summary: Credal LLMs maintain multiple predictive distributions to separate epistemic ignorance from aleatory ambiguity, improving calibration on ambiguous queries without sacrificing accuracy.

items.title: SplitLite: low-rank residual compression for split learning on-device LLMs
items.summary: Proposes a low-rank residual compression method reducing communication overhead in split learning while maintaining fine-tuning quality for on-device LLMs.

items.title: A physical response-and-memory model for Muon optimization
items.summary: Derives a physically-motivated optimizer from a response-and-memory model, achieving competitive training loss against Muon and AdamW while providing theoretical grounding for update rules.

items.title: Beyond the harness: end-to-end optimization of context artifacts for enterprise Text-to-SQL
items.summary: Shows that optimizing knowledge-base context artifacts (schema selection, table linking) outperforms model fine-tuning alone for enterprise Text-to-SQL.

items.title: TailSieve: partial-rollout-guided tail routing for LLM rollouts
items.summary: A routing system that redirects tail-latency requests to faster surrogate models guided by partial rollout analysis, improving throughput in RL training and evaluation pipelines.

items.title: NVIDIA Vera CPU detailed at Hot Chips 2026: 88-core Arm server processor with Olympus architecture
items.summary: NVIDIA presented its in-house Vera server CPU featuring 88 Olympus-architecture cores, LPDDR5X memory, 96 PCIe Gen6/CXL lanes, and NVLink-C2C interconnects as the CPU backbone of the Vera Rubin AI platform for confidential computing across the full rack.

items.title: Xiaomi launches Xring O3 mobile AI chip: first to break 5M on AnTuTu with LPDDR6 support
items.summary: Xiaomi's in-house Xring O3 flagship SoC on 3nm features a 10-core CPU and 16-core GPU delivering 85% higher graphics performance, 5.22M AnTuTu score, first LPDDR6 memory support at 113.8 GB/s, and 200 TOPS AI tensor performance.

items.title: IBM unveils dual-architecture mainframe processor running native Z and Arm on the same core
items.summary: IBM revealed its first dual-ISA processor for IBM Z and LinuxONE at Hot Chips 2026, where each core natively executes both z/Architecture and Arm AArch64 instructions on a 2nm process with 11 Z cores above 5.7 GHz.

items.title: Galbot humanoid completes 100+ autonomous tennis rallies at World Humanoid Robot Games
items.summary: Galbot's humanoids demonstrated the world's first live autonomous humanoid tennis match using the LATENT AI framework, tracking balls and executing varied shots without human control over 100 consecutive rallies.

items.title: Marvell pushes DDR4 recycling for CXL memory expansion amid worst DRAM shortage in years
items.summary: Marvell promotes CXL-based memory expansion using recycled DDR4 modules via Meta's Vistara ASIC, bridging two DDR4 channels for 128GB per chip from recovered server memory as the industry faces a severe DRAM shortage.

items.title: Construct Computer — AI coworker with cloud desktop and persistent memory
items.summary: An AI coworker platform giving each agent its own browser-based cloud desktop (browser, terminal, files, email, calendar) with persistent memory. Topped Product Hunt on August 24 with 313 upvotes.

items.title: Slack Code — AI coding agents in shared team channels
items.summary: Slack shipped a new channel type where teams and AI coding agents (Claude, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Vercel) collaborate in the same shared thread, launching with an Agents and Tools management hub.

items.title: Claude Academy — Anthropic's official learning hub for mastering Claude
items.summary: Anthropic launched an official learning hub with structured courses and tutorials to bridge AI education and adoption for Claude users.

items.title: Cybermes v2.0 — open-source AI red teaming agent for automated pentesting
items.summary: An autonomous offensive-security agent rewritten in Go, featuring 50+ security skills, a zero-false-positive gate, and automatic CVSS reporting under PolyForm Noncommercial license.

items.title: PicoMQ — durable streams over HTTP on object storage
items.summary: A messaging system providing durable HTTP streams backed by object storage, presented as a lightweight alternative to traditional message queues. Hit 108 points on Hacker News Show HN.

items.title: General Intuition in talks to raise at $6B valuation backed by Valor and Point72
items.summary: General Intuition, building foundation models for physical AI agents, is in talks at $6B pre-money with Valor Equity Partners, Point72 Ventures, and Seven Seven Six joining existing backers in an oversubscribed round for compute and robotics hiring.

items.title: Hugging Face reportedly in talks to be acquired for $13B
items.summary: The AI model hub is reportedly in acquisition talks at $13B+, having engaged banks to evaluate bids following surging demand for AI infrastructure. Last raised at $4.5B in 2023.

items.title: Oura reportedly eyeing September IPO at $16B+ valuation
items.summary: Smart ring maker Oura plans to raise up to $3B in a US IPO next month at a valuation north of $16B, jumping from $10.9B in its 2025 Series E. Backed by Fidelity, ICONIQ, and Whale Rock.
